name: Synapse
description: Drifting nodes wired to their neighbours, in four layers flying toward the camera. The node sparkle rides the low end, so the network fires on the beat rather than on a timer.

speed.description: How fast the layers fly past and the nodes wander.

layers.description: Depth layers. More means a denser, busier field.

glow.description: Vertical wash behind the network. This is the band-driven term - it swells with the low end.

drift.description: Parallax between layers. The source drove this from the mouse; here it is a slow orbit.
